title: B-Roll: 509 SFS Military Working Dog Water Aggression Training
description: Military working dogs assigned to 509th Security Forces Squadron perform water aggression training at a community pool in Sedalia, Missouri, Sept. 2, 2025. The training helped acclimate MWDs to an atypical environment and enhanced their capability to apprehend a target in water. (U.S. Air Force video by Senior Airman Bryce Moore)
